# Local Project Agent Workflow

Read `AGENTS.md` when it exists before applying these local workflow rules.
Before your first response or action:

1. Read `.agents/RULES.md`.
2. Read `.agents/overlays/codex/RULES.md` when it exists.
3. Read `.agents/memory/MEMORY.md`.

Canonical local skills live under `.agents/skills/`. Read a selected skill's
`SKILL.md` completely and then read its `overlays/codex.md` when present.
